title: seed-terraform-module-for-private-tenant-rbac-and-idempotent-policy-generation
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Private deployments need an idempotent, auditable way to bootstrap tenant-scoped RBAC and generate policy bundles from Terraform during installer runs. This PR seeds a small, composable Terraform module and supporting Helm hooks so the private installer can: 1) create tenant ServiceAccounts and KMS-encrypted secrets, 2) apply namespaced Role and RoleBinding templates with unique tenant prefixes, 3) produce a policy-bundle JSON artifact that the private control plane consumes for offline audits.

What this PR changes: adds a terraform/priv-tenant-rbac module (variables + outputs + example), a helm chart hook (post-install job) that runs the policy renderer, a small go-based policy-generator used by the job, and unit/integration test scripts that run in the private-installer CI matrix. The renderer emphasizes idempotency (compare-and-patch behavior) and deterministic output for stable audits.

Checklist: - [x] Terraform module with input validation and outputs - [x] Helm post-install hook job + K8s job manifest template - [x] Policy generator binary (Go) with deterministic JSON output - [x] Integration test harness (kind) exercising tenant bootstrap and rollback - [x] Documentation and example in examples/terraform/priv-tenant-quickstart.md

Notes/constraints: this is intentionally a minimal seed to be extended by the installer team; it does not include multi-cluster sync (future work: ENG-1801). The KMS integration is pluggable (accepts an encrypted blob or plaintext secret depending on installer configuration). For high-assurance deployments the role templates are conservative (least privilege) and include opt-in flags for additional permissions.
